spans.s: चुण r. 6th cl. (चुणति) To cut, to pierce or divide. तु-पर-सक-सेट् ।

चूण r. 10th cl. (चूणयति-ते) To contract, to close or shrink.
 E. चु-उभ-सक-
सेट् ।

चुण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A small well or reservoir near a well.
 E. चुडि to be low or
shallow, affixes अङ् and टाप्; also चुण्डी, the fem. affix being ङीष्.
चुण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A small well: see the preceding.
